name: Pulse Chutney
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 ½ inch (3 ½ cm) piece of ginger root

steps: Soak the green mung beans for 3–4 hours. Allow to sprout.
Mince the green chilies, fresh ginger, and salt.
Grind to a paste in a mortar and pestle or food processor.
Season with lemon juice to taste.

culture.text: Pulse chutney is an vegan Indian recipe. Use fewer chili peppers if you do not want it so hot.
